note: Alger County publishes no queryable zoning district layer. Zoning is administered by townships and the City of Munising; their zoning maps are PDFs (Onota Township Zoning Map PDF, Munising draft ordinance PDF). The county's GIS is a Colligo viewer (colligogis.com) with no public ArcGIS REST endpoint found for zoning. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for Alger County and Munising zoning returned no district layer.
